description: An order-intake agent. It reads incoming purchase orders from emails and documents, finds the customer, matches each line to your catalogue, converts units to your pack sizes, and applies each customer's notes and rules. Simple orders that pass every check can be confirmed automatically; everything else goes to a person to review, and each correction is saved so the same fix is not needed twice.

outcomes: Orders read from emails and documents into structured lines
Customer units converted to your pack sizes
Unclear orders sent to a person with the reason
Corrections saved so the same fix is not needed again
agent.role: Reads incoming purchase orders, matches them to your catalogue and prepares them for the warehouse.

name: order-desk
